hooks.name: Close-the-Loop Guard (Stop agent inject)
hooks.description: On Stop, inject last hook-runs.log failures into the same CLI turn. Trigger name is Stop (docs PascalCase for Agent Stop; not AgentStop).

action.prompt: Close-the-Loop Guard (same-turn): read the last 8 lines of `.kiro/hook-runs.log`. Prefer fixing exit!=0 lines whose file you edited this turn, using fs_read/fs_write only. Ignore close-loop-on-stop / close-loop-stop-log self-lines. If nothing actionable remains (or failures need shell you do not have), write one short note to `deploy/kiro-proof/close-loop-guard/CLOSE_LOOP_NOTE.txt` and end your reply with exactly: CLOSE_LOOP_OK. Do not edit unrelated game/HUD/combat files.

hooks.name: Close-the-Loop Guard (Stop command companion)
hooks.description: On Stop, mark STOP-FIRED.txt and write .kiro/NEXT-PROMPT.md for the next CLI run (durable fallback; does not claim same-turn LLM steering by itself).
